1.web: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
1.kjv: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
1.bsb: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,

1.web: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.
1.kjv: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
1.bsb: until the day He was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen.

1.web: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days, and speaking about God’s Kingdom.
1.kjv: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
1.bsb: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

1.web: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.
1.kjv: And, being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he , ye have heard of me.
1.bsb: And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.

1.web: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”
1.kjv: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
1.bsb: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”

1.web: Therefore when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”
1.kjv: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
1.bsb: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”

1.web: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.
1.kjv: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
1.bsb: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.

1.web: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
1.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
1.bsb: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”

1.web: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
1.kjv: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
1.bsb: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.

1.web: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,
1.kjv: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
1.bsb: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

1.web: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”
1.kjv: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
1.bsb: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.”

1.web: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
1.kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.
1.bsb: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

1.web: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room, where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.
1.kjv: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
1.bsb: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.

1.web: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.
1.kjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
1.bsb: With one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.

1.web: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,
1.kjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
1.bsb: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said,

1.web: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.
1.kjv: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
1.bsb: “Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.

1.web: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
1.kjv: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
1.bsb: He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.”

1.web: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness, and falling headlong, his body burst open, and all his intestines gushed out.
1.kjv: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
1.bsb: (Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.

1.web: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’
1.kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
1.bsb: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)

1.web: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell therein;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’
1.kjv: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
1.bsb: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’

1.web: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
1.kjv: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
1.bsb: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

1.web: beginning from the baptism of John, to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”
1.kjv: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
1.bsb: beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.”

1.web: They put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.
1.kjv: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
1.bsb: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.

1.web: They prayed, and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen
1.kjv: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
1.bsb: And they prayed, “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen

1.web: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”
1.kjv: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
1.bsb: to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.”

1.web: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias, and he was counted with the eleven apostles.
1.kjv: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
1.bsb: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.

2.web: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.
2.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
2.bsb: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

2.web: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
2.kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
2.bsb: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.

2.web: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
2.kjv: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
2.bsb: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

2.web: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
2.kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
2.bsb: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

2.web: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.
2.kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
2.bsb: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.

2.web: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.
2.kjv: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
2.bsb: And when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language.

2.web: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?
2.kjv: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilæans?
2.bsb: Astounded and amazed, they asked, “Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?

2.web: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?
2.kjv: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
2.bsb: How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?

2.web: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
2.kjv: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judæa, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
2.bsb: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,

2.web: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
2.kjv: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
2.bsb: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome,

2.web: Cretans and Arabians: we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”
2.kjv: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
2.bsb: both Jews and converts to Judaism; Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”

2.web: They were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”
2.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
2.bsb: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”

2.web: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
2.kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
2.bsb: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!”

2.web: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea, and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.
2.kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
2.bsb: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: “Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.

2.web: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.
2.kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
2.bsb: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!

2.web: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:
2.kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
2.bsb: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:

2.web: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.
2.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
2.bsb: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.

2.web: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.
2.kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
2.bsb: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.

2.web: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.
2.kjv: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
2.bsb: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

2.web: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.
2.kjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
2.bsb: The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord.

2.web: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
2.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
2.bsb: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

2.web: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,
2.kjv: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
2.bsb: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.

2.web: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;
2.kjv: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
2.bsb: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.

2.web: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
2.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
2.bsb: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for Him to be held in its clutches.

2.web: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, For he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.
2.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
2.bsb: David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

2.web: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope;
2.kjv: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
2.bsb: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,

2.web: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.
2.kjv: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
2.bsb: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.

2.web: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’
2.kjv: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
2.bsb: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’

2.web: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
2.kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
2.bsb: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

2.web: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,
2.kjv: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
2.bsb: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.

2.web: he foreseeing this spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.
2.kjv: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
2.bsb: Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.

2.web: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.
2.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
2.bsb: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.

2.web: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this, which you now see and hear.
2.kjv: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
2.bsb: Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.

2.web: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand,
2.kjv: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
2.bsb: For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand

2.web: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’
2.kjv: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
2.bsb: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’

2.web: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
2.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
2.bsb: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!”

2.web: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
2.kjv: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
2.bsb: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

2.web: Peter said to them, “Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
2.kjv: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
2.bsb: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

2.web: For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”
2.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
2.bsb: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”

2.web: With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
2.kjv: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
2.bsb: With many other words he testified, and he urged them, “Be saved from this corrupt generation.”

2.web: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
2.kjv: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
2.bsb: Those who embraced his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to the believers that day.

2.web: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
2.kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
2.bsb: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.

2.web: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
2.kjv: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
2.bsb: A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs.

2.web: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.
2.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
2.bsb: All the believers were together and had everything in common.

2.web: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
2.kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men , as every man had need.
2.bsb: Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.

2.web: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
2.kjv: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
2.bsb: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,

2.web: praising God, and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
2.kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
2.bsb: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

3.web: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
3.kjv: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour .
3.bsb: One afternoon Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

3.web: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.
3.kjv: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
3.bsb: And a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those entering the temple courts.

3.web: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
3.kjv: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
3.bsb: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.

3.web: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”
3.kjv: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
3.bsb: Peter looked directly at him, as did John. “Look at us!” said Peter.

3.web: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.
3.kjv: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
3.bsb: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.

3.web: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
3.kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
3.bsb: But Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

3.web: He took him by the right hand, and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
3.kjv: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
3.bsb: Taking him by the right hand, Peter helped him up, and at once the man’s feet and ankles were made strong.

5.bsb: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they returned with the report:

5.web: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”
5.kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
5.bsb: “We found the jail securely locked, with the guards posted at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside.”

5.web: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
5.kjv: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
5.bsb: When the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests heard this account, they were perplexed as to what was happening.

5.web: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”
5.kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
5.bsb: Then someone came in and announced, “Look, the men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people!”

5.web: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
5.kjv: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
5.bsb: At that point, the captain went with the officers and brought the apostles—but not by force, for fear the people would stone them.

5.web: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,
5.kjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
5.bsb: They brought them in and made them stand before the Sanhedrin, where the high priest interrogated them.

5.web: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”
5.kjv: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
5.bsb: “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name,” he said. “Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us responsible for this man’s blood.”

5.web: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
5.kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
5.bsb: But Peter and the other apostles replied, “We must obey God rather than men.

5.web: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
5.kjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
5.bsb: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you had killed by hanging Him on a tree.

5.web: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
5.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
5.bsb: God exalted Him to His right hand as Prince and Savior, in order to grant repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.

5.web: We are His witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”
5.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
5.bsb: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey Him.”

5.web: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
5.kjv: When they heard that , they were cut to the heart , and took counsel to slay them.
5.bsb: When the Council members heard this, they were enraged, and they resolved to put the apostles to death.

5.web: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
5.kjv: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
5.bsb: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a short time.

5.web: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
5.kjv: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
5.bsb: “Men of Israel,” he said, “consider carefully what you are about to do to these men.

5.web: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nothing.
5.kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
5.bsb: Some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men joined him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.

5.web: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
5.kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
5.bsb: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and drew away people after him. He too perished, and all his followers were scattered.

5.web: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
5.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
5.bsb: So in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone. Let them go! For if their purpose or endeavor is of human origin, it will fail.

5.web: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
5.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
5.bsb: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”

5.web: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
5.kjv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
5.bsb: At this, they yielded to Gamaliel. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and released them.

5.web: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.
5.kjv: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
5.bsb: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing that they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.

5.web: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.
5.kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
5.bsb: Every day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they did not stop teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.

6.web: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
6.kjv: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
6.bsb: In those days when the disciples were increasing in number, the Grecian Jews among them began to grumble against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.

6.web: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
6.kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
6.bsb: So the Twelve summoned all the disciples and said, “It is unacceptable for us to neglect the word of God in order to wait on tables.

6.web: Therefore select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
6.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
6.bsb: Therefore, brothers, select from among you seven men confirmed to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will appoint this responsibility to them

6.web: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
6.kjv: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
6.bsb: and will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word.”

6.web: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch;
6.kjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
6.bsb: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, as well as Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.

6.web: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
6.kjv: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
6.bsb: They presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

6.web: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem exceedingly. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
6.kjv: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
6.bsb: So the word of God continued to spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.

6.web: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
6.kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
6.bsb: Now Stephen, who was full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.

6.web: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
6.kjv: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
6.bsb: But resistance arose from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia. They began to argue with Stephen,

6.web: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
6.kjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
6.bsb: but they could not stand up to his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke.

6.web: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
6.kjv: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
6.bsb: Then they prompted some men to say, “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.”

6.web: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, and brought him in to the council,
6.kjv: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him , and caught him, and brought him to the council,
6.bsb: So they stirred up the people, elders, and scribes and confronted Stephen. They seized him and brought him before the Sanhedrin,

6.web: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
6.kjv: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
6.bsb: where they presented false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.

6.web: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
6.kjv: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
6.bsb: For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us.”

6.web: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
6.kjv: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
6.bsb: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.

7.web: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
7.kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
7.bsb: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”

7.web: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
7.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
7.bsb: And Stephen declared: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

7.web: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land, and from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
7.kjv: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
7.bsb: and told him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’

7.web: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land, where you are now living.
7.kjv: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
7.bsb: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, God brought him out of that place and into this land where you are now living.

7.web: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
7.kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
7.bsb: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised to give possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.

7.web: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
7.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
7.bsb: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

7.web: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that will they come out, and serve me in this place.’
7.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
7.bsb: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’

7.web: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
7.kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
7.bsb: Then God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. And Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs.

7.web: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,
7.kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
7.bsb: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him

7.web: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
7.kjv: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
7.bsb: and rescued him from all his troubles. He granted Joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and all his household.

7.web: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
7.kjv: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
7.bsb: Then famine and great suffering swept across Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers could not find food.

7.web: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
7.kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
7.bsb: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.

7.web: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s race was revealed to Pharaoh.
7.kjv: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
7.bsb: On their second visit, Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and his family became known to Pharaoh.

7.web: Joseph sent, and summoned Jacob, his father, and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
7.kjv: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him , and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
7.bsb: Then Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all.

7.web: Jacob went down into Egypt, and he died, himself and our fathers,
7.kjv: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
7.bsb: So Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our fathers died.

7.web: and they were brought back to Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
7.kjv: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
7.bsb: Their bones were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a price he paid in silver.

7.web: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
7.kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
7.bsb: As the time drew near for God to fulfill His promise to Abraham, our people in Egypt increased greatly in number.

7.web: until there arose a different king, who didn’t know Joseph.
7.kjv: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
7.bsb: Then another king, who knew nothing of Joseph, arose over Egypt.

7.web: The same took advantage of our race, and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to throw out their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
7.kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
7.bsb: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die.

7.web: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
7.kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:
7.bsb: At that time Moses was born, and he was beautiful in the sight of God. For three months he was nurtured in his father’s house.

7.web: When he was thrown out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and reared him as her own son.
7.kjv: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
7.bsb: When he was set outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.

7.web: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
7.kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
7.bsb: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.

7.web: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
7.kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
7.bsb: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

7.web: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
7.kjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
7.bsb: And when he saw one of them being mistreated, Moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian who was oppressing him.

7.web: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
7.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
7.bsb: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them, but they did not.

7.web: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
7.kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
7.bsb: The next day he came upon two Israelites who were fighting, and he tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why are you mistreating each other?’

7.web: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
7.kjv: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
7.bsb: But the man who was abusing his neighbor pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?

7.web: Do you want to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
7.kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
7.bsb: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

7.web: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
7.kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
7.bsb: At this remark, Moses fled to the land of Midian, where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons.

7.web: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
7.kjv: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
7.bsb: After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.

7.web: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, a voice of the Lord came to him,
7.kjv: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him,
7.bsb: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight. As he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came to him:

7.web: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled, and dared not look.
7.kjv: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
7.bsb: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.

7.web: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
7.kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
7.bsb: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.

7.web: I have surely seen the affliction of my people that is in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
7.kjv: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
7.bsb: I have indeed seen the oppression of My people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’

7.web: “This Moses, whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
7.kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
7.bsb: This Moses, whom they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ is the one whom God sent to be their ruler and redeemer through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

7.web: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
7.kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
7.bsb: He led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.

7.web: This is that Moses, who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
7.kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
7.bsb: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’

7.web: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
7.kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
7.bsb: He was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. And he received living words to pass on to us.

7.web: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him, and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
7.kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
7.bsb: But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.

7.web: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses, who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
7.kjv: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
7.bsb: They said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us! As for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.’

7.web: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
7.kjv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
7.bsb: At that time they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol, rejoicing in the works of their hands.

7.web: But God turned, and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
7.kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
7.bsb: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

7.web: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship. I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
7.kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
7.bsb: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.’

7.web: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
7.kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
7.bsb: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness. It was constructed exactly as God had directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.

7.web: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of David,
7.kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
7.bsb: And our fathers who received it brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations God drove out before them. It remained until the time of David,

7.web: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
7.kjv: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
7.bsb: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.

7.web: But Solomon built him a house.
7.kjv: But Solomon built him an house.
7.bsb: But it was Solomon who built the house for Him.

7.web: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
7.kjv: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
7.bsb: However, the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:

7.web: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
7.kjv: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
7.bsb: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me, says the Lord, or where will My place of repose be?

7.web: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
7.kjv: Hath not my hand made all these things?
7.bsb: Has not My hand made all these things?’

7.web: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
7.kjv: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did , so do ye.
7.bsb: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.

7.web: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
7.kjv: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
7.bsb: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute? They even killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One. And now you are His betrayers and murderers—

7.web: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
7.kjv: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
7.bsb: you who received the law ordained by angels, yet have not kept it.”

7.web: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
7.kjv: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
7.bsb: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.

7.web: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
7.kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
7.bsb: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

7.web: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
7.kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
7.bsb: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”

7.web: But they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and rushed at him with one accord.
7.kjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
7.bsb: At this they covered their ears, cried out in a loud voice, and rushed together at him.

7.web: They threw him out of the city, and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
7.kjv: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him : and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet, whose name was Saul.
7.bsb: They dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

7.web: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
7.kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God , and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
7.bsb: While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”

7.web: He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
7.kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
7.bsb: Falling on his knees, he cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

8.web: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
8.kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.
8.bsb: And Saul was there, giving approval to Stephen’s death. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.

8.web: Devout men buried Stephen, and lamented greatly over him.
8.kjv: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him.
8.bsb: God-fearing men buried Stephen and mourned deeply over him.

8.web: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house, and dragged both men and women off to prison.
8.kjv: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
8.bsb: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off men and women and put them in prison.

8.web: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
8.kjv: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
8.bsb: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.

8.web: Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and proclaimed to them the Christ.
8.kjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
8.bsb: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Christ to them.

8.web: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
8.kjv: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
8.bsb: The crowds gave their undivided attention to Philip’s message and to the signs they saw him perform.

8.web: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
8.kjv: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them : and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
8.bsb: With loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many who were possessed, and many of the paralyzed and lame were healed.

8.web: There was great joy in that city.
8.kjv: And there was great joy in that city.
8.bsb: So there was great joy in that city.

8.web: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city, and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
8.kjv: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
8.bsb: Prior to that time, a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and astounded the people of Samaria. He claimed to be someone great,

8.web: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”
8.kjv: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
8.bsb: and all the people, from the least to the greatest, heeded his words and said, “This man is the divine power called the Great Power.”

8.web: They listened to him, because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
8.kjv: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
8.bsb: They paid close attention to him because he had astounded them for a long time with his sorcery.

8.web: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
8.kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
8.bsb: But when they believed Philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

8.web: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
8.kjv: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
8.bsb: Even Simon himself believed and was baptized. He followed Philip closely and was astounded by the great signs and miracles he observed.

8.web: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
8.kjv: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
8.bsb: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them.

8.web: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;
8.kjv: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
8.bsb: On their arrival, they prayed for them to receive the Holy Spirit.

8.web: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.
8.kjv: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
8.bsb: For the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.

8.web: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
8.kjv: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
8.bsb: Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

8.web: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
8.kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
8.bsb: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.

8.web: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
8.kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
8.bsb: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”

8.web: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
8.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
8.bsb: But Peter replied, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!

8.web: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
8.kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
8.bsb: You have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right before God.

8.web: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
8.kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
8.bsb: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.

8.web: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
8.kjv: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
8.bsb: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and captive to iniquity.”

8.web: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
8.kjv: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
8.bsb: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”

8.web: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
8.kjv: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
8.bsb: And after Peter and John had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many of the Samaritan villages.

8.web: But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”
8.kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
8.bsb: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”

8.web: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
8.kjv: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
8.bsb: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official in charge of the entire treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. He had gone to Jerusalem to worship,

8.web: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
8.kjv: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
8.bsb: and on his return was sitting in his chariot reading Isaiah the prophet.

8.web: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”
8.kjv: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
8.bsb: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go over to that chariot and stay by it.”

8.web: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
8.kjv: And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
8.bsb: So Philip ran up and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.

8.web: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
8.kjv: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
8.bsb: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone guides me?” And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.

8.web: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.
8.kjv: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
8.bsb: The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth.

8.web: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
8.kjv: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
8.bsb: In His humiliation He was deprived of justice. Who can recount His descendants? For His life was removed from the earth.”

8.web: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
8.kjv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
