8.bsb: “Tell me,” said the eunuch, “who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”

8.web: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.
8.kjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
8.bsb: Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

8.web: As they went on the way, they came to some water, and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
8.kjv: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
8.bsb: As they traveled along the road and came to some water, the eunuch said, “Look, here is water! What is there to prevent me from being baptized?”

8.kjv: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

8.web: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
8.kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
8.bsb: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

8.web: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
8.kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
8.bsb: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more, but went on his way rejoicing.

8.web: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.
8.kjv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Cæsarea.
8.bsb: But Philip appeared at Azotus and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he came to Caesarea.

9.web: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,
9.kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
9.bsb: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the Lord. He approached the high priest

9.web: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.
9.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
9.bsb: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

9.web: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
9.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
9.bsb: As Saul drew near to Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

9.web: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
9.kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
9.bsb: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”

9.web: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
9.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
9.bsb: “Who are You, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” He replied.

9.web: But rise up, and enter into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
9.kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
9.bsb: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”

9.web: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
9.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
9.bsb: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless. They heard the voice but did not see anyone.

9.web: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
9.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
9.bsb: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could not see a thing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.

9.web: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
9.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
9.bsb: For three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything.

9.web: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
9.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here , Lord.
9.bsb: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, “Ananias!” “Here I am, Lord,” he answered.

9.web: The Lord said to him, “Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
9.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
9.bsb: “Get up!” the Lord told him. “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.

9.web: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
9.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
9.bsb: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”

9.web: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
9.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
9.bsb: But Ananias answered, “Lord, many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.

9.web: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
9.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
9.bsb: And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name.”

9.web: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
9.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
9.bsb: “Go!” said the Lord. “This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.

9.web: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
9.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
9.bsb: I will show him how much he must suffer for My name.”

9.web: Ananias departed, and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me, that you may receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
9.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
9.bsb: So Ananias went to the house, and when he arrived, he placed his hands on Saul. “Brother Saul,” he said, “the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

9.web: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
9.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
9.bsb: At that instant, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and his sight was restored. He got up and was baptized,

9.web: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
9.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
9.bsb: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. And he spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.

9.web: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
9.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
9.bsb: Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”

9.web: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”
9.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
9.bsb: All who heard him were astounded and asked, “Isn’t this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”

9.web: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
9.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
9.bsb: But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.

9.web: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,
9.kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
9.bsb: After many days had passed, the Jews conspired to kill him,

9.web: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
9.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
9.bsb: but Saul learned of their plot. Day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him.

9.web: but his disciples took him by night, and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
9.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
9.bsb: One night, however, his disciples took him and lowered him in a basket through a window in the wall.

9.web: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
9.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
9.bsb: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

9.web: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.
9.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
9.bsb: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how Saul had seen the Lord, who spoke to him on the road to Damascus, and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus.

9.web: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,
9.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
9.bsb: So Saul stayed with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.

9.web: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
9.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
9.bsb: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.

9.web: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him off to Tarsus.
9.kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cæsarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
9.bsb: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

9.web: So the assemblies throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.
9.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judæa and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
9.bsb: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria experienced a time of peace. It grew in strength and numbers, living in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.

9.web: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.
9.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
9.bsb: As Peter traveled throughout the area, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.

9.web: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
9.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Æneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
9.bsb: There he found a man named Aeneas, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.

9.web: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.
9.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Æneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
9.bsb: “Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and put away your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up,

9.web: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.
9.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
9.bsb: and all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.

9.web: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated, means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
9.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
9.bsb: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which is translated as Dorcas), who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity.

9.web: In those days, she became sick, and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
9.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
9.bsb: At that time, however, she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upper room.

9.web: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
9.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
9.bsb: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples heard that Peter was there and sent two men to urge him, “Come to us without delay.”

9.web: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
9.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
9.bsb: So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.

9.web: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
9.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
9.bsb: Then Peter sent them all out of the room. He knelt down and prayed, and turning toward her body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter, she sat up.

9.web: He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
9.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
9.bsb: Peter took her by the hand and helped her up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.

9.web: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
9.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
9.bsb: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.

9.web: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
9.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
9.bsb: And Peter stayed for several days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

10.web: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,
10.kjv: There was a certain man in Cæsarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,
10.bsb: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was called the Italian Regiment.

10.web: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.
10.kjv: A devout man , and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
10.bsb: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God regularly.

10.web: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
10.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
10.bsb: One day at about the ninth hour, he had a clear vision of an angel of God who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”

10.web: He, fastening his eyes on him, and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.
10.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
10.bsb: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?” The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.

10.web: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.
10.kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
10.bsb: Now send men to Joppa to call for a man named Simon who is called Peter.

10.web: He lodges with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
10.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
10.bsb: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.”

10.web: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
10.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
10.bsb: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among his attendants.

10.web: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.
10.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
10.bsb: He explained what had happened and sent them to Joppa.

10.web: Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
10.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
10.bsb: The next day at about the sixth hour, as the men were approaching the city on their journey, Peter went up on the roof to pray.

10.web: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
10.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
10.bsb: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.

10.web: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
10.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
10.bsb: He saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.

10.web: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
10.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
10.bsb: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, as well as birds of the air.

10.web: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
10.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
10.bsb: Then a voice said to him: “Get up, Peter, kill and eat!”

10.web: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
10.kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
10.bsb: “No, Lord!” Peter answered. “I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”

10.web: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
10.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
10.bsb: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”

10.web: This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.
10.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
10.bsb: This happened three times, and all at once the sheet was taken back up into heaven.

10.web: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,
10.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,
10.bsb: While Peter was puzzling over the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found Simon’s house and approached the gate.

10.web: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.
10.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
10.bsb: They called out to ask if Simon called Peter was staying there.

10.web: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.
10.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
10.bsb: As Peter continued to reflect on the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men are looking for you.

10.web: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”
10.kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
10.bsb: So get up! Go downstairs and accompany them without hesitation, because I have sent them.”

10.web: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”
10.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
10.bsb: So Peter went down to the men and said, “Here am I, the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”

10.web: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”
10.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
10.bsb: “Cornelius the centurion has sent us,” they said. “He is a righteous and God-fearing man with a good reputation among the whole Jewish nation. A holy angel instructed him to request your presence in his home so he could hear a message from you.”

10.web: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.
10.kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
10.bsb: So Peter invited them in as his guests. And the next day he got ready and went with them, accompanied by some of the brothers from Joppa.

10.web: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
10.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
10.bsb: The following day he arrived in Caesarea, where Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

10.web: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
10.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him .
10.bsb: As Peter was about to enter, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet to worship him.

10.web: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
10.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
10.bsb: But Peter helped him up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”

10.web: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
10.kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
10.bsb: As Peter talked with him, he went inside and found many people gathered together.

10.web: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.
10.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
10.bsb: He said to them, “You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.

10.web: Therefore also I came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”
10.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
10.bsb: So when I was invited, I came without objection. I ask, then, why have you sent for me?”

10.web: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour, and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
10.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
10.bsb: Cornelius answered: “Four days ago I was in my house praying at this, the ninth hour. Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me

10.web: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.
10.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
10.bsb: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before God.

10.web: Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He lodges in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’
10.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
10.bsb: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon, who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’

10.web: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”
10.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
10.bsb: So I sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has instructed you to tell us.”

10.web: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;
10.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
10.bsb: Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,

10.web: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
10.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
10.bsb: but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.

10.web: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
10.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
10.bsb: He has sent this message to the people of Israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.

10.web: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
10.kjv: That word, I say , ye know, which was published throughout all Judæa, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
10.bsb: You yourselves know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed:

10.web: even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
10.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
10.bsb: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.

10.web: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
10.kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
10.bsb: We are witnesses of all that He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. And although they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree,

10.web: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,
10.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
10.bsb: God raised Him up on the third day and caused Him to be seen—

10.web: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
10.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
10.bsb: not by all the people, but by the witnesses God had chosen beforehand, by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead.

10.web: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
10.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
10.bsb: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.

10.web: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”
10.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
10.bsb: All the prophets testify about Him that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.”

10.web: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
10.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
10.bsb: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message.

10.web: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.
10.kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
10.bsb: All the circumcised believers who had accompanied Peter were astounded that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles.

10.web: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,
10.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
10.bsb: For they heard them speaking in tongues and exalting God. Then Peter said,

10.web: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”
10.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
10.bsb: “Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have!”

10.web: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
10.kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
10.bsb: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay for a few days.

11.web: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
11.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
11.bsb: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

11.web: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
11.kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
11.bsb: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers took issue with him

11.web: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!”
11.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
11.bsb: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”

11.web: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
11.kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
11.bsb: But Peter began and explained to them the whole sequence of events:

11.web: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
11.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
11.bsb: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.

11.web: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
11.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
11.bsb: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.

11.web: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
11.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
11.bsb: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’

11.web: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
11.kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
11.bsb: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’

11.web: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
11.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
11.bsb: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’

11.web: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
11.kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
11.bsb: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.

11.web: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
11.kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cæsarea unto me.
11.bsb: Just then three men sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.

11.web: The Spirit told me to go with them, without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
11.kjv: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:
11.bsb: The Spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s home.

11.web: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa, and get Simon, who is called Peter,
11.kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
11.bsb: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.

11.web: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
11.kjv: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
11.bsb: He will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved.’

11.web: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
11.kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
11.bsb: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning.

11.web: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
11.kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
11.bsb: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, as He used to say, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’

11.web: If then God gave to them the same gift as us, when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
11.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
11.bsb: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”

11.web: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
11.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
11.bsb: When they heard this, their objections were put to rest, and they glorified God, saying, “So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.”

11.web: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
11.kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
11.bsb: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message only to Jews.

11.web: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
11.kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
11.bsb: But some of them, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began speaking to the Greeks as well, proclaiming the good news about the Lord Jesus.

11.web: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
11.kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
11.bsb: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.

11.web: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
11.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
11.bsb: When news of this reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

11.web: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
11.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
11.bsb: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.

11.web: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
11.kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
11.bsb: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.

11.web: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
11.kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
11.bsb: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,

11.web: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
11.kjv: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
11.bsb: and when he found him, he brought him back to Antioch. So for a full year they met together with the church and taught large numbers of people. The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.

11.web: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
11.kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
11.bsb: In those days some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

11.web: One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
11.kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cæsar.
11.bsb: One of them named Agabus stood up and predicted through the Spirit that a great famine would sweep across the whole world. (This happened under Claudius.)

11.web: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
11.kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judæa:
11.bsb: So the disciples, each according to his ability, decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea.

11.web: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
11.kjv: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
11.bsb: This they did, sending their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul.

12.web: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
12.kjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
12.bsb: About that time, King Herod reached out to harm some who belonged to the church.

12.web: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.
12.kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
12.bsb: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.

12.web: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.
12.kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
12.bsb: And seeing that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.

12.web: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
12.kjv: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
12.bsb: He arrested him and put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

12.web: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.
12.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
12.bsb: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to God for him.

12.web: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.
12.kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
12.bsb: On the night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, with sentries standing guard at the entrance to the prison.

12.web: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side, and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off from his hands.
12.kjv: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
12.bsb: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He tapped Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Get up quickly.” And the chains fell off his wrists.

12.web: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak, and follow me.”
12.kjv: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
12.bsb: “Get dressed and put on your sandals,” said the angel. Peter did so, and the angel told him, “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me.”

12.web: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
12.kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
12.bsb: So Peter followed him out, but he was unaware that what the angel was doing was real. He thought he was only seeing a vision.

12.web: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out, and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
12.kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
12.bsb: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city, which opened for them by itself. When they had gone outside and walked the length of one block, the angel suddenly left him.

12.web: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”
12.kjv: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
12.bsb: Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod’s grasp and from everything the Jewish people were anticipating.”

12.web: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
12.kjv: And when he had considered the thing , he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
12.bsb: And when he had realized this, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered together and were praying.

12.web: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a maid named Rhoda came to answer.
12.kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
12.bsb: He knocked at the outer gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.

12.web: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in, and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.
12.kjv: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
12.bsb: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed that she forgot to open the gate, but ran inside and announced, “Peter is standing at the gate!”

12.web: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”
12.kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
12.bsb: “You are out of your mind,” they told her. But when she kept insisting it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”

12.web: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.
12.kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door , and saw him, they were astonished.
12.bsb: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.

12.web: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James, and to the brothers.” Then he departed, and went to another place.
12.kjv: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
12.bsb: Peter motioned with his hand for silence, and he described how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. “Send word to James and to the brothers,” he said, and he left for another place.

12.web: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.
12.kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
12.bsb: At daybreak there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.

12.web: When Herod had sought for him, and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, and commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
12.kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judæa to Cæsarea, and there abode.
12.bsb: After Herod had searched for him unsuccessfully, he examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent some time there.

12.web: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
12.kjv: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country .
12.bsb: Now Herod was in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they convened before him. Having secured the support of Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their region depended on the king’s country for food.

12.web: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
12.kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
12.bsb: On the appointed day, Herod donned his royal robes, sat on his throne, and addressed the people.

12.web: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
12.kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
12.bsb: And they began to shout, “This is the voice of a god, not a man!”

12.web: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.
12.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
12.bsb: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.

12.web: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
12.kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
12.bsb: But the word of God continued to spread and multiply.

12.web: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.
12.kjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
12.bsb: When Barnabas and Saul had fulfilled their mission to Jerusalem, they returned, bringing with them John, also called Mark.

13.web: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
13.kjv: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
13.bsb: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch), and Saul.

13.web: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”
13.kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
13.bsb: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”

13.web: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
13.kjv: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
13.bsb: And after they had fasted and prayed, they laid their hands on them and sent them off.

13.web: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.
13.kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
13.bsb: So Barnabas and Saul, sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.

13.web: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They had also John as their attendant.
13.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
13.bsb: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. And John was with them as their helper.

13.web: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,
13.kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:
13.bsb: They traveled through the whole island as far as Paphos, where they found a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,

13.web: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.
13.kjv: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
13.bsb: an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, a man of intelligence, summoned Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.

13.web: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
13.kjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
13.bsb: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.

13.web: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,
13.kjv: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
13.bsb: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked directly at Elymas

13.web: and said, “Full of all deceit and all cunning, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
13.kjv: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
13.bsb: and said, “O child of the devil and enemy of all righteousness, you are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery! Will you never stop perverting the straight ways of the Lord?

13.web: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
13.kjv: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
13.bsb: Now look, the hand of the Lord is against you, and for a time you will be blind and unable to see the light of the sun.” Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

13.web: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
13.kjv: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
13.bsb: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord.

13.web: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.
13.kjv: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
13.bsb: After setting sail from Paphos, Paul and his companions came to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.

13.web: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat down.
13.kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
13.bsb: And from Perga, they traveled inland to Pisidian Antioch, where they entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and sat down.

13.web: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”
13.kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
13.bsb: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue leaders sent word to them: “Brothers, if you have a word of encouragement for the people, please speak.”

13.web: Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.
13.kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
13.bsb: Paul stood up, motioned with his hand, and began to speak: “Men of Israel and you Gentiles who fear God, listen to me!

13.web: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
13.kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
13.bsb: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers. He made them into a great people during their stay in Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out of that land.

13.web: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
13.kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
13.bsb: He endured their conduct for about forty years in the wilderness.

13.web: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.
13.kjv: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
13.bsb: And having vanquished seven nations in Canaan, He gave their land to His people as an inheritance.

13.web: After these things he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
13.kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
13.bsb: All this took about 450 years. After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.

13.web: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.
13.kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
13.bsb: Then the people asked for a king, and God gave them forty years under Saul son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin.

13.web: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’
13.kjv: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
13.bsb: After removing Saul, He raised up David as their king and testified about him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse a man after My own heart; he will carry out My will in its entirety.’

13.web: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
13.kjv: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
13.bsb: From the descendants of this man, God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as He promised.

13.web: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.
13.kjv: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
13.bsb: Before the arrival of Jesus, John preached a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

13.web: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’
13.kjv: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he . But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
13.bsb: As John was completing his course, he said, ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not that One. But He is coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’

13.web: Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
13.kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
13.bsb: Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.

13.web: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
13.kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him .
13.bsb: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning Him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.

13.web: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.
13.kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
13.bsb: And though they found no ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have Him executed.

13.web: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.
13.kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
13.bsb: When they had carried out all that was written about Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb.

13.web: But God raised him from the dead,
13.kjv: But God raised him from the dead:
13.bsb: But God raised Him from the dead,

13.web: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
13.kjv: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
13.bsb: and for many days He was seen by those who had accompanied Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now His witnesses to our people.

13.web: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,
13.kjv: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
13.bsb: And now we proclaim to you the good news: What God promised our fathers

13.web: that God has fulfilled the same to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’
13.kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
13.bsb: He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.’

13.web: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
13.kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
13.bsb: In fact, God raised Him from the dead, never to see decay. As He has said: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’

13.web: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’
13.kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm , Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
13.bsb: So also, He says in another Psalm: ‘You will not let Your Holy One see decay.’

13.web: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, and was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.
13.kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
13.bsb: For when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep. His body was buried with his fathers and saw decay.

13.web: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.
13.kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
13.bsb: But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.

13.web: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins,
13.kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
13.bsb: Therefore let it be known to you, brothers, that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.

13.web: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.
13.kjv: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
13.bsb: Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything you could not be justified from by the law of Moses.

13.web: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
13.kjv: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
13.bsb: Watch out, then, that what was spoken by the prophets does not happen to you:

13.web: ‘Behold, you scoffers, and wonder, and perish; for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”
13.kjv: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
13.bsb: ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’”

13.web: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.
13.kjv: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
13.bsb: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people urged them to continue this message on the next Sabbath.

13.web: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.
13.kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
13.bsb: After the synagogue was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who spoke to them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.

13.web: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.
13.kjv: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
13.bsb: On the following Sabbath, nearly the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.

13.web: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.
13.kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
13.bsb: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy, and they blasphemously contradicted what Paul was saying.

13.web: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.
13.kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
13.bsb: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.

13.web: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
13.kjv: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
13.bsb: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’”

13.web: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
13.kjv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
13.bsb: When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord, and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.

13.web: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
13.kjv: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
13.bsb: And the word of the Lord spread throughout that region.

13.web: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
13.kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
13.bsb: The Jews, however, incited the religious women of prominence and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.

13.web: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.
13.kjv: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
13.bsb: So they shook the dust off their feet in protest against them and went to Iconium.

13.web: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
13.kjv: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
13.bsb: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

14.web: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.
14.kjv: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
14.bsb: At Iconium, Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue, where they spoke so well that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.

14.web: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.
14.kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
14.bsb: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
